fields.label: Branding history

Net Metering (Solar)
fields.description: How solar consumers' exported units are credited (FS-CFG-23, FS-BIL-13). Applies to connections whose meter is a Net Metering meter.

fields.label: Net Metering Method
fields.options:
Net units
Buyback rate
Society rebate pool
fields.description: Net units: imports less exports, the rest carried forward. Buyback rate: imports billed in full, exports credited at the tariff's buyback rate. Society rebate pool: each month the society's rebate pool (residents' imports less the DISCO's import) is shared among solar consumers in proportion to their exports.

fields.label: Rounding of Credited Units
fields.options:
Nearest unit (half up)
Round down
Round up
No rounding

fields.label: FPA and QTA on Solar Accounts
fields.description: The units of the reference month that FPA and QTA are charged on for a net-metering account.
Earlier bills listed on each bill (1 to 24).
fields.label: Months of History on Bill

fields.description: A tear-off office/bank copy at the foot of each bill.
fields.label: Print Office Copy
Subtotal for Each Charge Group
fields.description: The bill lists its charges under their groups (for example electricity, society and government charges), each with its own total. A charge the tariff sets at zero still prints, so a group can total zero.
QR code of the reference number, for paying through banks and wallets.
fields.label: Show QR Code
Bills per Service
fields.options:
Separate bill per service
One combined bill per billing account
fields.description: Separate: each service (electricity, maintenance, water...) gets its own bill. Combined: the services of a billing account are printed and paid as one bill, each with its own section.

fields.label: Show Barcode
fields.description: Code 128 barcode of the reference number, for bank counters' scanners. Independent of the QR code: print either, both or neither.

fields.label: Print the Meter Photo
fields.description: The photo taken with the reading is printed beside the readings, so the consumer sees the meter as read.

fields.label: Payment Link
fields.description: The address a phone opens, with {reference_no}, {amount}, {due_date} or {bill} filled in from the bill. For example https://pay.example.pk/?ref={reference_no}&amount={amount}

fields.label: Second Language on the Bill
fields.description: Labels printed in this language beside the English, right to left.

fields.label: Notices in the Second Language
fields.description: One notice per line.

fields.label: Payment Instructions in the Second Language

fields.description: Printed on every bill, one notice per line.
fields.label: Notices on Bill

fields.description: How and where to pay. Bank accounts marked Print on Bill are listed below it.
fields.label: Payment Instructions

fields.description: An amount above the balance is kept as credit and used on the next bill
fields.label: Allow Overpayments

fields.description: Charged to the account each time a duplicate bill is issued; leave empty for none
fields.label: Duplicate Bill Fee

fields.default: Not paid in full by the due date
fields.description: Checked the day after the due date + grace days, by the date the consumer paid. 'Nothing paid' waives the surcharge if any payment was made by then.
fields.label: Surcharge Applies When
fields.options:
Not paid in full by the due date
Nothing paid by the due date

fields.description: Account codes for summary journals (FS-GL-01). Charge types and fees carry their own income accounts.

fields.description: Bill lines without a charge type, such as the minimum bill adjustment
fields.label: Other Billing Income

fields.description: Credit and debit notes
fields.label: Bill Adjustments and Waivers
Cash and Bank Accounts by Payment Mode

fields.description: The model the society is permitted to operate under (FS-CFG-39)
fields.label: Operating Model
fields.options:
Cost allocation
Internal distribution
Resale
Management fee

fields.description: Used by the line loss reports and the dashboard: below Watch is Normal, from High is High loss.
fields.label: Line Loss Alert Levels
Defaulters and Recovery
fields.description: Who counts as a defaulter and when each recovery stage is issued (FS-REC-04, 05).

fields.label: Notifications
fields.description: Which message goes by which channel for each event (FS-NTF-01, 04, 06). An empty table uses the defaults.

fields.label: WhatsApp On
fields.description: Switch off to stop all WhatsApp messages.

fields.label: Quiet Hours From
fields.description: Ordinary messages wait until quiet hours end; critical ones go out.

fields.label: Corrections
fields.description: Limits for due date extensions and what follows a dishonoured cheque (FS-WF-03, 11).

fields.label: Longest Due Date Extension (days)
fields.description: A Billing Manager can extend up to this; a General Manager beyond it.

fields.label: Dishonoured Cheque Fee
fields.description: Charged when a cheque or pay order is reversed as dishonoured.

fields.label: Cash Only After a Dishonoured Cheque
Bill Fixed Charges for Part Months Only
fields.description: A connection that starts or is disconnected during the month pays its fixed and per-area charges for the days it was connected.

fields.label: Payment arrangements and approvals
fields.description: Installment rules, the write-off account and who approves what by amount (FS-CFG-18, FS-ACC-04, FS-WF-04, 05, 14).

fields.label: Write-off Expense Account
fields.description: Where written-off receivables are booked (bad debts).

fields.label: Held Receivables Account
fields.description: Amounts owed but set aside by a court order (for example a DISCO's deferred amounts): part of the receivables, kept apart until released or written off.

fields.label: Approval Order
fields.options:
Any level that covers the amount
Each level in turn
fields.default: Any level that covers the amount
fields.description: Each level in turn: a document above level 1's limit is approved by level 1, then level 2 and so on up to the level that covers its amount; one person can't approve at two levels.

fields.label: Approval Levels by Amount
fields.description: For each transaction, who approves up to which amount. With none set: a General Manager approves adjustments, refunds, bulk adjustments and write-offs; a Billing Manager approves installment plans.

fields.label: Splitting a Month at a Change
fields.options:
By the change-day reading, else by days
By days
Off
fields.default: By the change-day reading, else by days
fields.description: When the tariff, the category or the account holder changes inside a reading period, the month is billed in two parts: the units by the reading taken on the change day when there is one (else by days), fixed charges by days. A tariff change has no reading, so it is split by days. A holder change gives the outgoing holder a final bill. Off: a tariff or category change applies to the whole month; a holder change still gives a final bill, split by days (FS-CFG-05, FS-BIL-02).

fields.label: Security Deposits Held (Liability) Account
fields.description: Where security deposits are held as a liability (FS-MST-10).

fields.label: Waiting approvals and service rules
fields.description: Reminders and escalation of items waiting for approval (FS-ACC-07); disconnection notice and reconnection fee (FS-CFG-18).

fields.label: Disconnection Notice (days)
fields.description: A disconnection takes effect at least this many days after it is requested, except for safety.

fields.label: Account Changes Only Through Service Requests
fields.description: An active account's category, load, holder and meters are changed by a service request, not on the account form. The Administrator can still correct data (kept in the version log).

fields.label: Reconnection Fee
fields.description: Charged on a reconnection request when its type has no fee of its own.

fields.label: Channel fees and commissions
fields.description: What each payment channel charges the society, for the channel fees report (FS-RPT-22).

fields.label: Revenue assurance
fields.description: Thresholds for the monthly revenue assurance checks (FS-RA). Each finding becomes a case to investigate.

fields.label: Drop: Below % of Own Average
fields.description: Flag a bill whose units are below this share of the account's average over the history months.

fields.label: Drop: Below % of Similar Accounts
fields.description: …and below this share of the median of similar accounts (same category and plot size).

fields.label: Estimated Bills Allowed in a Row
Residential Load Limit (kW)
fields.description: A residential account whose sanctioned load or maximum demand (MDI) is above this is flagged.

fields.label: Adjustments by One User in a Month Above
fields.description: Flag a user whose reversals and adjustments in a month add up to more than this (0 = only the statistical check).

fields.label: Go-live
fields.description: Opening balances brought over from the previous system (Opening Balance Import).

fields.label: Opening Balances Account
fields.description: The account the opening receivables and deposits are set against (for example an opening balance equity or suspense account).

fields.label: Live Since
fields.description: Set when opening balances are posted: nothing can be dated before this day.

fields.label: Old Account Numbers Accepted Until
fields.description: Old account numbers from the previous system are searchable, accepted for payments and printed on bills up to this day. Set to six months after go-live when the opening balances post; empty before go-live (accepted).

fields.label: Defective meters and disconnected accounts
fields.description: How a defective meter is billed until it is replaced (FS-WF-08), and whether fixed charges continue while an account is disconnected.

fields.label: Defective-Meter Billing
fields.options:
Average of last N months
Same month last year
Load × load factor × hours
Minimum charge only

fields.label: Average Billing for at Most (months)
fields.description: After this many months the meter is billed fixed charges only and stays on the Defective Meters report until replaced.

fields.label: Fixed Charges While Disconnected
fields.options:
Stop from the disconnection date
Continue
fields.description: Continue: disconnected accounts are billed their fixed and per-area charges every month (no energy, no minimum charge).
